REM BadUSB MSC - Example: Flipper to Windows
REM Copies BADUSBMSC\FLIPTEST.TXT to FLIPBACK.TXT on the Desktop.
REM Run EXAMPLE_TRANSFER.txt first to create the source file.
REM Use only on a PC you own or are allowed to test.
DELAY 2000
GUI r
DELAY 700
STRING powershell -NoProfile
ENTER
DELAY 1800
REM Find the Windows Desktop and BADUSBMSC volume
STRING $desk=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')
ENTER
DELAY 300
STRING $v=Get-Volume -FileSystemLabel BADUSBMSC -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
ENTER
DELAY 700
REM Copy the same test file back, leaving the original on BADUSBMSC
STRING if($v -and $v.DriveLetter){$src=$v.DriveLetter+':\FLIPTEST.TXT';if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $src){Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination (Join-Path $desk 'FLIPBACK.TXT') -ErrorAction Stop;notepad (Join-Path $desk 'FLIPBACK.TXT')}else{Write-Host 'FLIPTEST.TXT not found'}}else{Write-Host 'BADUSBMSC not found'}
ENTER
